Stows out.

1r1lif1.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.
> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.
This introductory contract will require you to head to [LOCATION] and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.
Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

lu3z04.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR74382
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
A known outlaw attacked and destroyed a ship near [LOCATION]. The agency has been contracted to retrieve the ship’s blackbox in order to build a case against them and lobby for Advocacy intervention.
Contract Investigator Actions:
An operative is needed to head to the crime scene at [LOCATION], secure the area from any hostiles present to procure the blackbox, and deliver to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be advised that there are still hostile forces in the area that will attack. These will most likely have some experience fighting, so be prepared.
This contract has been flagged as a combat mission.
lu3z04.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR74382
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
一伙已知的不法分子在 [LOCATION] 附近袭击并摧毁了一艘飞船。事务所已委托你回收该飞船的黑匣子，以便为他们建立案件并争取督导局的介入。

合约调查员的行动：
需要一名特工前往 [LOCATION] 的犯罪现场，确保该区域安全，排除任何敌对势力，然后取回黑匣子并将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
请注意，该地区仍有敌对势力存在，它们可能会有战斗经验，因此要做好准备。

此合约已被标记为战斗任务。

ea11ju.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
ea11ju.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

aqosc4.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a [TARGET], who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an emission cloud near [LOCATION] which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

1ba0aeo.description_en:
Hey,
Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?
Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send you the creds.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1ba0aeo.description_zh:
嘿，

事情是这样的，我们一个运输员在 [LOCATION] 那儿出了状况，船直接被放弃了。你能过去帮我们把这单货送完吗？

活儿不算大，但你还是得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能塞下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿就行，我们立马把报酬打给你。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: An operator working with InterSec is currently being attacked by Vanduul ships at [LOCATION]. The likelihood of them surviving on their own is low, so we’re looking for a contractor willing to provide combat support.
Contractors accepting this mission should be well supplied and ready to face the Vanduul threat head-on.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

1vzg6hx.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files.
Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
1vzg6hx.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：

1hxgmvm.description_en:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at [LOCATION].
Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.
Head there with a crew of your own and a heavy-duty tractor beam to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.
Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.
-Twitch
1hxgmvm.description_zh:
一帮对手摸清了我的送货路线，现在他们把我的一艘货船围在 [LOCATION] 了。

那帮混蛋全守着船，肯定在等谁派运输船去接货，所以你得赶在他们前面到。

带齐你的兄弟过去，再拎上重型牵引光束，直接把货抢回来，别像我把他们当软柿子。

干掉他们，把货送回 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，我保证让你赚翻。

- 刺痛

2plp4k.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Minor Mining Job
WORK BRIEF:
If you’ve got time, I’ve got a pretty basic mining job for you. I'm building a database of mineral types and their locations but I need some raw data, so I need someone to locate [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]. You can keep what you find, I'll pull the data I need. [RARITY]
Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.
Thanks.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
2plp4k.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

工作简报：
你要是有空的话，手头有个挺简单的采矿活儿。我正在建立一个矿物类型及其位置的数据库，但我需要一些原始数据，所以得找个人去找 [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]。你找到的东西可以归你，我只取我需要的数据。[RARITY]

另外，如果你不知道去哪找矿或者刚接触采矿，联合资源工人协会写了一本很有用的指南，你应该去看看。它就在你的手环里。

谢谢。

确认扫描并提取整个区域后，按标准列出的费率结算。

雷科·巴塔利亚

p8ijbs.description_en:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to [LOCATION] with the required supplies and perform some repairs.
As it stands, you’ll need six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so. That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
p8ijbs.description_zh:

这些物资将协助恢复前哨站运转。我们将补偿您的时间与材料损耗。

维修细则请参照 mobiGlas 日志中 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员

1vrnssf.description_en:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.
Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.
- Stows
1vrnssf.description_zh:
事情是这样的，我们有一些小混球，觉得自己很了不起，正在 [LOCATION] 附近的一个基地里活动。我不知道他们喝了什么毒东西，搞得他们以为去招惹猎头帮飞船是个好主意。杀了一个，伤了三个。所以我想派人去把他们的雄心彻底打掉。

去把他们干掉，你会得到一笔丰厚的奖励。

- 斯托斯

1dhcw35.description_en:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [LOCATION] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.
We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
1dhcw35.description_zh:
尽管我们努力倡导非暴力，但当地的非法团伙依然持续攻击我们的组织。异种威胁最近袭击了 [LOCATION] ，把我们在那里工作的志愿者驱赶了出去。

我们希望招募战斗人员来夺回这个前哨站。理想情况下，我们希望能找个办法促使他们撤退，但异种威胁很快就会通过暴力来解决他们的所有问题，因此毫无疑问会发生一场战斗。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1a91dj7.description_en:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an [TARGET] and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near [LOCATION]. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack.
Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [TARGET] is aggressive and battle hardened.
You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of 16 MG Scrip in it for the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
1a91dj7.description_zh:
我们收到了一些关于 [AMBUSHTARGET] 及其护航船最近发动攻击的通讯。在打开一个文件后，我们开始追踪这艘船的动向，发现它经常经过靠近 [LOCATION] 的辐射云。我们想利用这一点发起一次突袭。

一旦到达现场，你应该藏身于辐射云中，以足够掩盖你的信号，争取先发制人。不幸的是，福克斯韦尔无法为这次行动提供额外的增援，所以你需要负责带来任何支援力量。你可能也需要帮助。这支 [AMBUSHTARGET] 的队伍非常好斗且战斗经验丰富。

帮我们搞定这事，就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证 当奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿

1anqt92.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We appreciate how hard you’ve been working for us recently, which is why we’d like to offer you this advanced contract. An important client of ours is waiting for delivery on multiple packages but the courier due to deliver them is no longer responding. The package trackers are showing that they’re at [LOCATION], meaning we have some time to recover the delivery.
PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 5x [ITEM1]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]
We cannot stress enough how important the success of this delivery is. Since we do not know what happened to the original courier, we strongly urge you to travel with several trustworthy combat pilots.
Needless to say, we’re offering a substantial payout for this one proportionate to the danger of the contract.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
1anqt92.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们非常感谢你最近为我们付出的努力，因此想为你提供这份高级任务。我们一位重要客户正等待多个包裹的送达，但负责派送的快递员已失联。包裹追踪器显示它们位于 [LOCATION]，这意味着我们还有时间去追回这些货物。

要找回的包裹
     · 5x [ITEM1]

卸货地点
     · 送至 [DESTINATION]

我们再怎么强调这次送货成功的重要性都不为过。由于我们不知道原快递员发生了什么，强烈建议你带上几位值得信赖的战斗飞行员一同前往。

不用说，这次任务的报酬会非常高，与任务的危险程度相匹配。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

zu9ob6.description_en:
Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
zu9ob6.description_zh:
你好啊，

如果你加装了加油设备，可能会喜欢这个任务。

一个信标刚刚在 [LOCATION] 附近上线。是一位客户的委托，他的 [SHIP] 需要 [FUELTYPE]

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

看起来是个零麻烦、一次搞定就完事的活，但保持扫描器开启总没坏处。
如有兴趣请告知，我们好让这些人顺利启程。

静候佳音，

迪娜·德洛特

Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.
The fools are operating from [LOCATION]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.
- Stows out.
1nz3fwd.description_zh:
一些混蛋拒绝支付我们应得的报酬。问题是，这些蠢货还到处炫耀。要是他们保持沉默的话我们还能用更有效方法解决这个问题，但现在我们需要给他们个下马威。

这帮蠢货在 [LOCATION]。我们需要他们全部消失，动静越大越好，等所有人都处理干净了，我们会把你的报酬发过去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

15l6kb7.description_en:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.
Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.
- Stows
15l6kb7.description_zh:
有个新冒出来的帮派正让猎头帮头疼得要命，他们居然把 [OBJECTS] 给盯上了，地点就在 [LOCATION]。这事儿可不太妙，毕竟我们很在意那边人的安危，更别提要是让他们搞出大动静，搞不好会把接下来的行动全搅黄了。

你一到那儿就赶紧去阻止他们，别让他们造成永久性破坏。要是发现有友方飞船需要帮忙，你也得搭把手。别指望这帮家伙好对付，但只要你保持冷静，应该还是能摆平他们的。

要是你还缺点动力，那么我特意给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

zsh67q.description_en:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.
Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.
With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to [LOCATION] in order to take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.
If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.
Best of luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
zsh67q.description_zh:
我本不该让别人冒这么大的风险，但眼下情况特殊。

我们的飞行员在运送一批关键货物时，遭到了一伙不法分子的袭击。无论如何，绝不能让他们得手。

鉴于袭击者规模庞大，单凭你一人无法完成任务。你必须带上一支技术过硬的队伍，前往 [LOCATION]，击溃这批不法分子并夺回货物。请确保队伍中至少有一人驾驶的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，并配备一把 重型牵引光束。

倘若奇迹发生、你真能把这批货物抢回来，请将其运至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。

这要求确实很高，但若你能成功，我本人及整个组织都将对你深表感激。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

132xa03.description_en:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at [LOCATION], along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto.
Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip for a job well done.
Stows out.
132xa03.description_zh:
我们需要的不仅是能进行空中缠斗的人，还要能招募其他人加入猎头帮的事业。我们的行动中心位于 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION]，所有进出那里的飞船都遭到了敌对势力的袭击。我们急需支援。

说实话，那边的情况很棘手，敌人的火力很猛。所以你得确保物资充足，再找几个信得过的朋友跟你一起飞。等你组好队伍，出发过去，如果那边有任何突发情况，我会及时通知你。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我打算给完成任务的主要承包人额外奖励 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

tncauu.description_en:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.
I want you to fly to [LOCATION] and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.
Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.
-Stows out
tncauu.description_zh:
人们什么时候才能明白，他们不能在猎头的地盘上随心所欲？这些白痴正在策划一项大工程，还以为我会让他们逍遥？绝对不可能。

我想让你飞往 [LOCATION]，摧毁他们的燃料罐和数据服务器。让他们看看猎头们对他们的真实看法。

让我们看看他们在那之后还能怎么做。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

16htb93.description_en:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life.
Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet.
Go to [LOCATION] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.
-Stows out
16htb93.description_zh:
似乎我每天醒来都免不了听到我的人抱怨繁荣公民让他们的生活有多困难。

最终我们会把那些自以为是的“好人”从这个星系赶出去，但我现在就想要一点安静。

去 [LOCATION] 毁掉繁荣公民在那里的燃料储备。这样至少能让他们暂时不来干扰我们。

u417za.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
u417za.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

Hiya,
Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.
Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.
As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

1h65t47.description_en:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.
If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.
[TARGET] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.
You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.
They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION], so get there and take care of it.
Stows out.
1h65t47.description_zh:
你知道我们是谁，你知道我们在做什么。星系有点拥挤，所以我们在寻找一些优秀的士兵来帮助我们在这里立足。

如果你愿意，也不介意弄脏手，我们有办法证明你具备我们所需要的素质。

[TARGETNAME] 是我们曾经的成员，他背叛了我们，把我们出卖给了异种威胁，导致我们的一些兄弟姐妹被杀。现在他们以为可以毫无后果地过日子。

你把他们解决掉，你就能得到晋升，公平的交易。

他们最近在 [LOCATION] 附近被发现，所以赶紧过去处理掉他们。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION]

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for a heavy Antium armor set. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."

请注意，为了加快这些材料未来的使用效率，它们必须在交付前进行精炼。这可以在任何精炼厂完成，其位置可在你的星图中找到。

satmlr.description_en:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy?
We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a [TARGET]. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that [LOCATION] is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.
Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.
Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
satmlr.description_zh:
想帮我们对付坏蛋吗？

我们被雇来追捕一名驾驶 [AMBUSHTARGET] 的不法分子。这应该不太难，因为他们每天都走同样的飞行路线。这让他们成为了绝佳的伏击目标。我分析了路线，认为 [LOCATION] 是发动攻击的理想地点。在那里有一片辐射云，正好可以隐藏你的飞船信号，等着他们经过。

如果你感兴趣，工作很简单。前往指定地点，藏起来，关闭动力，然后等他们飞过。有时他们会单独行动，但他们通常会带着其他单座飞船。对于专业人士来说，这应该不算太难。此外，我们附近还有增援力量，随时准备出动，一旦情况升级就可以支援你。

搞定这事儿，我们就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

Okay, this might be a bit of stretch to do on your own, so if you got any favors to call in, it could be good to cash those chits now. There's a group of desperados striking delivery ships up and down this sector and we've been tasked with cleaning them up.
Once your crew is ready, head over to [LOCATION] and take the hostiles there down. Now, these bastards are a bit clever so they tend to split up into smaller packs. Make sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives."
j5f2jx.description_zh:
好吧，这活儿单靠你一个人可能有点悬，要是你手头还有人情能用，现在正好派上用场。最近这一带有一帮亡命之徒，专挑运输船下手，搞偷袭，上上下下搅得够呛。我们被指派去收拾他们。

等你们团队准备好了，就直接去 [LOCATION] 那儿，把那帮敌人一锅端了。不过提醒一句，这帮家伙脑子不笨，经常分头行动、化整为零，所以你得多蹲一会儿，确保一个都不漏掉。

vbolmf.description_en:
Hey,
Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.
Pick up Corundum from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul 1 SCU cargo containers.
Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
